question: Anay does the 5/11th part of the work in 10 days and Rohan does the 5/6th of the same work in 15 days. They started together but Rohan left the work 5 days before the completion of the work and Anay completed the work. Find the number of days after which Rohan left work.
solution:
Given:

Anay does 5/11 of the work in 10 days

⇒ Anay completes the work in 22 days

Rohan does 5/6 of the work in 15 days

⇒ Rohan completes the work in 18 days

Rohan left 5 days before the completion

Formula Used:

Total Work = Efficiency × Time
